WITH date_dim_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_moy
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq IN (1222,1222+1,1222+2,1222+3,1222+4,1222+5,1222+6,1222+7,1222+8,1222+9,1222+10,1222+11)
),
matched_sales AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_sales_price, i.i_manager_id, dd.d_moy
    FROM date_dim_filtered AS dd
    JOIN store_sales AS ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN item AS i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN store AS s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE i.i_category IN ('Books','Children','Electronics')
      AND i.i_class IN ('personal','portable','reference','self-help')
      AND i.i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14','scholaramalgamalg #7','exportiunivamalg #9','scholaramalgamalg #9')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ss.ss_sales_price, i.i_manager_id, dd.d_moy
    FROM date_dim_filtered AS dd
    JOIN store_sales AS ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN item AS i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN store AS s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE i.i_category IN ('Women','Music','Men')
      AND i.i_class IN ('accessories','classical','fragrances','pants')
      AND i.i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1','edu packscholar #1','exportiimporto #1','importoamalg #1')
),
monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT m.i_manager_id, m.d_moy, SUM(m.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales
    FROM matched_sales AS m
    GROUP BY m.i_manager_id, m.d_moy
),
manager_monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT ms.i_manager_id, AVG(ms.sum_sales) AS avg_monthly_sales
    FROM monthly_sales AS ms
    GROUP BY ms.i_manager_id
),
ranked_sales AS (
    SELECT ms.i_manager_id, ms.sum_sales, ma.avg_monthly_sales,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ms.i_manager_id, ma.avg_monthly_sales, ms.sum_sales) AS rn
    FROM monthly_sales AS ms
    JOIN manager_monthly_avg AS ma ON ms.i_manager_id <=> ma.i_manager_id
    WHERE (ABS(ms.sum_sales - ma.avg_monthly_sales) / ma.avg_monthly_sales) > 0.1
)
SELECT i_manager_id, sum_sales, avg_monthly_sales
FROM ranked_sales
WHERE rn <= 100
ORDER BY i_manager_id, avg_monthly_sales, sum_sales
LIMIT 100
